title: Personal Care Retail EDI: Match Retailer Item Numbers to Shades, Sizes, and Sets
summary: Retailer item numbers on Orderful purchase orders resolve to the NetSuite shade, size or set revision, and that line survives through ASN and invoice.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Personal-care retail EDI requires an exact crosswalk from retailer item numbers to shades, sizes, and sets. Preserve the partner’s line and packaging definition through order acceptance, shipment, and invoice. Technical document validation cannot detect every commercially wrong product mapping, so verify item meaning before release.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
